description: Ministry of Defence - Emergencey Orders, Places of Detention
reasoning: This gazette content announces the designation of specific police stations and departments as official places of detention under the Emergency Orders (Various Provisions and Powers) bearing No. 01 of 2019. It is a legal/regulatory notice issued under statutory authority (Section 19 of the emergency orders) to implement detention provisions, making it a matter of legal framework and regulatory compliance rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any other specialized category.
